askDorway.q: Which leads haven't been followed up today?
askDorway.a: 4 leads are due today with no follow-up yet: Vikram Joshi (Arjun) — quote sent 2 days ago, no reply. Suresh Menon (Rahul) — asked if the offer is still valid. Kavya Rao (Priya) — requested a callback. Imran Sheikh — unassigned.

askDorway.q: Show me prospects asking about pricing.
askDorway.a: 9 conversations this week mention price, budget or quotation. 6 have an owner and a follow-up scheduled. 3 don't: Vikram Joshi, Deepa Iyer and Imran Sheikh.

askDorway.q: Which conversations look ready for a call?
askDorway.a: Farah Khan and Neha Sharma. Both have confirmed budget, asked about timelines and replied within an hour of the last message.

askDorway.q: Summarise what happened with this lead.
askDorway.a: Neha Sharma came in from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad on Monday asking about a 2BHK modular kitchen. Priya shared the catalogue and ₹1.8L starting price. A site visit is booked for Saturday, 11 AM.
Arjun has 2 untouched leads from this afternoon. Everyone else has replied to all new enquiries.
